children: RNS Number : 2066W  Arc Minerals Limited  24 September 2026
, provides the following update pursuant to Rule 17 and Schedule 2 (g) (v) of the AIM Rules.

Rémy Welschinger, Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, was a director of Viridian Lithium SAS, a French private company, within 12 months preceding its entry into administration on 9 March 2026.
